title: Nobel Committee chair pushes human accountability for AI’s potential harms | The wRap
summary: Today’s headlines: Artificial Intelligence, Sara Duterte, Ping Lacson

blocks.text: Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Nobel Committee chair emphasizes human accountability for AI’s potential harms

blocks.text: Nobel Committee chair Jørgen Watne Frydnes says that people behind AI technologies, as well as governments that utilize them, must be held accountable if these systems inflict harm.

items: Ex-Cale88 co-owner, BOC official to testify in Sara Duterte impeachment trial

blocks.text: Former Cale88 Foods Corporation co-owner Dr. Lourdes Tingson-Lebosada is expected to testify during Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial.

items: Lacson asks: Why settle unpaid 2024 DSWD guarantee letters in 2027?

blocks.text: Senator Ping Lacson flags the proposed special provision in the House version of the 2027 budget bill. – Rappler.com
